statement: Linux v7.3 uses USB input report 0x01 with 64 bytes and Bluetooth input report 0x31 with 78 bytes and a checked trailing CRC; both feed the same DualSense common parser, including Edge controls. For output, the driver uses USB report 0x02 with 63 bytes and Bluetooth report 0x31 with 78 bytes and a trailing CRC.

applicability.scope: Linux v7.3 USB versus Bluetooth HID report paths; actual device reports not captured
